texto: Every sound starts with something that vibrates. A stretched string vibrates: it moves very fast from side to side. That vibration is what makes the sound!
Your mission. Pluck the string 3 times and watch it vibrate.
The vibration moves the air. The air is full of tiny particles. When the drum vibrates it pushes the air, and the particles push the ones next to them: that is how sound travels!
Your mission. Hit the drum 3 times and watch the wave travel.
The wave reaches your ear. The air wave reaches your ear. Your ear vibrates too and your brain understands: it is a sound! The farther away, the softer it sounds.
Your mission. Ring the bell with the ear close, then far away.
Loud, soft, high and low. If the vibration is big, the sound is loud. If it is tiny, it is soft. If it vibrates fast, the sound is high; if it vibrates slowly, it is low.
Your mission. Play a low bar (left) and a high bar (right). Then a loud sound and a soft one.
